maddeler.e:
استقصيا (form X)
# اِسْتَقْصَيَا (istaqṣayā) /is.taq.sˤa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَقْصَى (istaqṣā)
# اُسْتُقْصِيَا (ustuqṣiyā) /us.tuq.sˤi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَقْصَى (istaqṣā)
# اِسْتَقْصِيَا (istaqṣiyā) /is.taq.sˤi.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَقْصَى (istaqṣā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
